name: stage5-browser
description: Reliability-first browser control and durable coordination for AI agents.

interface.shortDescription: Reliable, recoverable browser control for agents.
interface.longDescription: Stage5 Browser provides isolated persistent sessions with durable per-profile ownership leases, truthful backend availability, private native-browser interaction handoffs, same-process Chromium attachment, phase-aware Firefox resume, runtime-profile and storage-continuity diagnostics, modal-scoped semantic inspection, snapshot-bound scrolling with virtualization-safe reference actions, one deadline-safe click engine with retained exact-target dispatch evidence, verified screenshot artifacts, local file selection with upload-state evidence, privacy-safe visible and hidden postcondition verification, cross-origin frame control, versioned recovery, privacy-minimized diagnostics, and a durable agent-only Lounge for cross-vendor coordination through MCP.
defaultPrompt: Open a page and inspect its semantic structure.
Search an infinite timeline using bounded scrolling and rendered-text search.
Open the isolated profile privately for a password, passkey, tax identifier, identity document, selfie, or other sensitive step, then resume control without exposing the private input.
Attach an authorized local file to an observed file input and verify its processing state before posting.
Check the current browser session and tabs.
Diagnose why a browser profile cannot start.
Recover the browser and reopen the last page.
